source: CDC National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES)
derived_target_methodology: Derived CKD Indicator based on KDIGO 2012 guidelines and CKD-EPI 2021 race-free equation. Positive (1) if eGFR < 60 mL/min/1.73m2 OR Urine Albumin-to-Creatinine Ratio (UACR) >= 30 mg/g; Negative (0) if eGFR >= 60 mL/min/1.73m2 AND UACR < 30 mg/g. Participants lacking both laboratory measurements were excluded to prevent non-random label distortion. As cross-sectional survey data cannot verify 3-month chronicity, this label represents derived CKD indicators rather than clinically confirmed chronic disease.
limitations_and_sources_of_bias: Cross-sectional design: Single spot urine and serum measurements cannot establish 90-day persistence required for formal KDIGO diagnosis.
Survey weights: Model is trained on unweighted survey sample participants for clinical decision-support classification rather than population prevalence estimation.
Laboratory imputation: Missing clinical predictors are imputed with median/mode within the preprocessing pipeline during inference.
Generalizability: Dataset reflects non-institutionalized US civilian population; external validation in diverse primary care cohorts is required before diagnostic deployment.
